title: Making me tap “Ok” button million times
body:
Given: 
- I have multiple Outlook accounts logged in the Calendar app
- I have multiple devices (iPad, iPhone, Mac)

When: 
- someone of my colleagues schedules a set of meetings at once (let’s say 10 meetings for upcoming month)

Then:
- I accept meetings on one of my devices (A) by clicking “Accept” to each of 10 invites
- I have to tap/click “OK” on the rest of diveces

So 10 clicks on “Accept” on device A + 20 clicks on “OK” on devices B and C, so 30 actions! Multiply that by multiple accounts I have in my Calendar. 

If I do not tap “Ok”, number on the app badge does not change, so I steel see “10” on all devices and in some time it is kind of stress - 10 NEW meetings that I have to accept or 10, that I haven’t tapped “OK” for. 

The most strange thing is that Apple support says “It is expected, as per design” that sounds like “We designed as is and we’re not going to change it despite the fact it inconvenient”. 

“Customer focused” 👍🏽
